projects.name: EvalOps for tool-using enterprise agents
projects.purpose: Evaluation harness turning workflow requirements and observed agent failures into reproducible tasks, executable verifiers, statistical reports, and regression gates.

milestones.title: Skeleton
milestones.acceptance: Task schema, environment interface, trajectory schema, deterministic verifier skeleton committed with tests

milestones.title: Environments and failures
milestones.acceptance: Two environments, failure injection, first baseline, at least 20 trajectories manually inspected

milestones.title: Metrics and statistics
milestones.acceptance: Task-level metrics, stratified slices, bootstrap CIs, paired comparison tested on synthetic fixtures

milestones.title: Annotation calibration
milestones.acceptance: Pilot instructions, three-annotator study, agreement measured, rubric revised once, pre/post reported

milestones.title: Release v0.1
milestones.acceptance: Tests/CI/typing/lint pass; credential-free smoke; design doc and demo published; three reviewer criticisms tracked; fresh clone runs the smoke suite

milestones.title: Regression gates
milestones.acceptance: Three observed failures converted into regression tasks; thresholds enforced in CI

milestones.title: Technical report
milestones.acceptance: Baseline/ablation matrix run; report includes baselines, ablations, uncertainty, failure taxonomy, limitations; auditable from configs and artifacts

projects.name: Distributed training and rollout reliability lab
projects.purpose: Production-style runner plus a deliberately small distributed-training workload: distributed correctness, rollout tooling, profiling, failure handling, clean engineering.

milestones.title: Runners and DDP design
milestones.acceptance: Sequential and Ray runners, bounded concurrency, retries with jitter, idempotent task IDs, checkpoint/resume design

milestones.title: Load and profile
milestones.acceptance: Rollout load test at three concurrency levels and two batching settings; torch.profiler evidence; throughput/latency explained from measurements

milestones.title: DDP and recovery
milestones.acceptance: Single vs two-process DDP correctness; interrupted run resumes without duplicated samples; container, benchmark report, demo; profiling quantifies a real bottleneck with before/after

milestones.title: Comparison and post
milestones.acceptance: Finalized profiling comparison; engineering post titled around a measured bottleneck

projects.name: Verifier-guided post-training mini-lab
projects.purpose: Optional: verifier-guided post-training on one narrow task with a genuinely small model, evaluated on held-out tasks.

milestones.title: SFT baseline
milestones.acceptance: Narrow verifiable task and small open model selected; clean SFT baseline built

milestones.title: Method and rewards
milestones.acceptance: One preference or verifiable-reward method run; deterministic verifiers as rewards; reward components and KL/entropy logged

milestones.title: Ablation
milestones.acceptance: Reward-design ablation complete; reward hacking and generalization failures inspected

milestones.title: Report
milestones.acceptance: Reproducible configs, training/eval curves, ablation table, held-out evaluation with confidence intervals, model card, what-would-change-at-scale section; positive result not required
